title: Northwind pick-path pilot kickoff
contextText: Kickoff for the pick-path optimisation pilot with Northwind Robotics. Sarah is our exec sponsor.

segments.text: Okay, I think everyone's here. Thanks for making the time. This is the kickoff for the pick-path pilot, so I'd like to cover scope, timeline and who owns what.
Great. For the record, I'm Sarah Chen, VP of Operations at Northwind Robotics. I'm sponsoring this on our side.
And I'm Tomás Aguilar, I'm an engineer on the warehouse systems team. I'll be the day-to-day technical contact.
Priya Raman, engineering manager at Larkspur. I'll be staffing the team from our side.
Perfect. So the short version: we want to prove that re-ordering pick paths based on live order mix cuts walking distance for pickers.
Right, and I want to be clear on where. My preference is that we run this in Building 3 only. It's our most predictable site and the floor supervisors there are open to trying things.
Building 3 only works for us. Do we all agree on that as the scope?
Yes, Building 3 has the newest shelving too, so the location data is cleaner.
Then let's call it decided. Building 3 only for the pilot.
On timing, what are you telling your leadership?
The pilot is scheduled for Q1. That's what's in our operating plan and what the board has seen.
Q1 is tight but doable if we get the floor data early.
Which brings me to data. Sarah, can your team get us the current floor plans and the shelf location export?
Yes. I'll send the floor plans and the location export by next Tuesday.
Thank you. Priya, on our side?
I'll staff two engineers on this from the start of February. JJ is one of them, the other I'll confirm this week.
Will they need access to the warehouse management system directly or can we work from exports?
Exports are fine for the first month. We don't want to touch production systems until we've earned it.
Good, because anything touching the WMS directly will need sign-off from the CIO eventually, and that takes weeks.
Understood. We'll plan around exports.
One more thing, and this is just how I work: I'd much rather get a short written update every Friday than another recurring call. My calendar is already a mess.
That's easy. Friday written updates it is.
Can I be copied on those? I'd like to see what the engineers are seeing.
Of course. Tomás, you'll be on every update.
Last thing from me, do we have a named person on your side for security questions?
Tomás can route those. He knows who to ask.
Great. So to recap: Building 3 only, target Q1, floor plans by next Tuesday, and Friday written updates. Thanks everyone.

note.body:
# Northwind pick-path pilot kickoff

**Date:** January 8
**Attendees:** Alex Rivera (Larkspur Labs), Priya Raman (Larkspur Labs), Sarah Chen (Northwind Robotics), Tomás Aguilar (Northwind Robotics)

## Summary

Kickoff for the pick-path pilot with Northwind Robotics. The goal is to show that re-ordering pick paths based on the live order mix reduces picker walking distance. Sarah Chen, VP of Operations, is the executive sponsor; Tomás Aguilar, an engineer on the warehouse systems team, is the day-to-day technical contact.

## Decisions

- The pilot will run in **Building 3 only**, Northwind's most predictable site with the newest shelving and cleaner location data.
- The team will work from data exports for the first month rather than connecting to the warehouse management system directly.

## Timeline

Sarah confirmed that the pilot is scheduled for Q1; this is what appears in Northwind's operating plan and what their board has seen. Priya considers Q1 tight but achievable if floor data arrives early.

## Action items

- **Sarah Chen** — send the Building 3 floor plans and shelf location export by next Tuesday.
- **Priya Raman** — staff two engineers on the pilot from the start of February (JJ plus one more, to be confirmed this week).
- **Alex Rivera** — send a short written update every Friday, copying Tomás.

## Notes

- Any direct integration with the warehouse management system will eventually need sign-off from Northwind's CIO, which takes weeks, so the plan avoids it for now.
- Sarah prefers a short written update every Friday over another recurring call.
- Tomás will route security questions to the right people at Northwind.
